evidence_label: Human-observed Azure Data Explorer free cluster synthetic KQL execution
method: Each exact query in executed/ was run with a temporary inline KQL datatable shadowing the source table; 7 result grids were visually inspected during the interactive session. These results are human-transcribed, not API-exported or cryptographically signed. Source query hashes are checked against the saved files.
limitations: Recorded query snapshots use absolute timestamps from 2026-10-15 and have time-relative filters; running those snapshots later may produce zero results. Use generated/ for replay anchored to the time of execution.

The generated replay and assertion bundles were not the exact files executed during the original browser session. They preserve the fixture values, source query text and relative timings, and must be independently executed to earn their own cloud execution claim.
The evidence is a manual result transcription from observed browser output; no signed service-side export or external audit trail is supplied.
Synthetic source table shadows do not verify Sentinel/Defender connectors, schema deployment, real audit operation populations, detection sensitivity, or production false positives.
